queries: GPT chess illegal moves 2023 board state tracking evaluation paper

sources_considered.why: Contemporary primary evaluation of GPT-3.5 chess behavior; read_page returned full text.
Relevant research on state tracking, but its specially trained models do not directly establish the cause of contemporary ChatGPT failures.
Primary intervention experiments challenge the general inference that next-token prediction cannot learn board representations. Different models and a later period make this context.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Mu-Tien Kuo, Chih-Chung Hsueh, and Richard Tzong-Han Tsai
evidence_items.explanation: The experiments document substantial problems following chess rules in GPT-3.5-turbo-0301. They support the behavioral premise, but do not isolate reliance on correlations as its cause.

The author reports interventions in chess-model activations that change moves in line with altered board states. This challenges a blanket opposition between statistical training and internal models, but does not settle the cause of failures in the GPT systems Marcus discussed.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved controlled study establishes the claimed causal chain in the relevant contemporary GPT systems.
The claim provides no test separating fragile correlations from an imperfect learned representation.
